C0763.title: Project GT Partner Leaked Business Plan Leads to Fraudulent Crowdfunding Incident
C0763.summary: In June 2026, Siphon Studio, developer of Project GT, alleged that an external organization used materials from an early industry-facing business plan leaked by a partner to launch a fake Kickstarter campaign and impersonate the official team for fraud. The incident forced the developer to issue urgent clarifications and pursue complaints and rights protection, exposing supply-chain leakage risks around partner material circulation, business plan confidentiality, and external authorization management.

references.title: Siphon Studio Statement on Fraudulent Kickstarter Campaign Impersonating Project GT
